name: Salmon Prawn Risotto
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical risotto recipe quantities (150g rice + 1L stock + proteins/veg yields ~4 adult main-dish portions).

Preparation time estimated from sequential steps: onion/rice cooking (~15 min), gradual stock absorption with stirring (~20 min), salmon grilling (~8-10 min), plus lemon/seasoning/asparagus prep and final assembly; total active ~45 min.
Parmesan classified as dairy (milk); butter as dairy (milk); salmon as fish; prawns as shellfish; no wheat, eggs, nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame listed.
Asparagus, lemon, onion, stock, wine, pepper, and rice (assuming standard risotto rice) introduce no listed allergens.

Recipe is pescatarian (includes fish/shellfish but no meat); not vegetarian/vegan due to salmon, prawns, butter, and Parmesan; gluten-free as no barley/rye/wheat/oats; not dairy-free due to butter and Parmesan.
instructions:
Melt the butter in a thick-based pan and gently cook the onion without colour until it is soft.
Add the rice and stir to coat all the grains in the butter
Add the wine and cook gently stirring until it is absorbed
Gradually add the hot stock, stirring until each addition is absorbed. Keep stirring until the rice is tender
Season with the lemon juice and zest, and pepper to taste. (there will probably be sufficient saltiness from the salmon to not need to add salt) Stir gently to heat through
Serve scattered with the Parmesan and seasonal vegetables.
Grill the salmon and gently place onto the risotto with the prawns and asparagus
